vocabulary.definition: carrying out a systematic inquiry or examination into a subject to discover facts or gain information
vocabulary.example: She is investigating her family history to trace her roots back to her ancestors.

vocabulary.definition: a group or system of interconnected people or things
vocabulary.example: The underground roots form a network linking trees to other trees in the forest.
Mother trees send nutrients to their offspring to help them grow strong and healthy.

vocabulary.definition: the capacity of an individual to act independently and make their own choices
vocabulary.example: Trees exhibit agency by making decisions to help ensure their survival and growth.

vocabulary.definition: the events that will necessarily happen to a particular person or thing in the future
vocabulary.example: The dying tree seemed to understand its destiny and warned its offspring to prepare for the future.
The parent trees show preference to their kin by sending more nutrients to their own seedlings.
